t: Workflow State Store - public implementations survey
title: Workflow State Store - public implementations survey
definition: Saves the current state of long-running workflows.
description:
This database surveys Workflow State Store as it exists in public practice: Saves the current state of long-running workflows. The records below name real tools with real track records, explain the techniques they are built on, cite the standards they implement, and provide drills that build working skill. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

The value of a survey like this is comparative: seeing seven real implementations side by side reveals what the capability truly requires and where each tool draws its boundaries. The technique records go deeper, explaining the machinery - the algorithms, protocols and disciplines - that make Workflow State Store work regardless of which tool you pick.

Use this database as a field guide. When a build calls for Workflow State Store, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.
